name: healthcare-fhir
description: Build healthcare integrations with HL7 FHIR: resources, profiles, terminology, interoperability, PHI safety. Use for EHR/health-data work. Defensive/compliance-aware.

name: fintech-payments
description: Build payment/fintech flows: PCI scope, idempotency, reconciliation, webhooks, ledgers, currency. Use for payments integration. Never handle raw card data yourself.
pitfalls: Storing raw card data (PCI scope explosion)
Float math on money (use integer minor units)

name: ecommerce-platform
description: Build e-commerce: catalog, cart, checkout, inventory, promotions, order lifecycle. Use for storefronts/commerce backends.
pitfalls: Overselling from race conditions on inventory

name: legal-tech
description: Build legal-tech: contract data models, clause libraries, e-signature flows, audit trails, retention. Use for legal/document workflows.
pitfalls: Treating generated text as legal advice

name: edtech
description: Build education tech: courses, LMS, LTI, progress tracking, assessments, accessibility. Use for learning platforms.

name: proptech
description: Build real-estate tech: listings, geospatial search, valuations, maps, IoT for smart buildings. Use for proptech apps.

name: insurtech
description: Build insurance tech: quoting, underwriting rules, claims, actuarial data, compliance. Use for insurtech systems.

name: adtech
description: Build ad tech: auctions (RTB), tracking, attribution, frequency capping, privacy (consent). Use for advertising systems. Privacy-first.

name: tinyml-edge-ai
description: Run ML on microcontrollers/edge (TensorFlow Lite Micro/Edge Impulse): quantization, memory, latency. Use for on-device ML.
pitfalls: Model too big for MCU RAM/flash

name: ar-filters
description: Build AR filters/effects (Lens Studio/Spark/8thWall): face/world tracking, shaders, performance. Use for AR experiences.

name: digital-twins
description: Build digital twins: real-time device state, simulation, telemetry, sync, what-if analysis. Use for IoT/industrial twins.

name: iot-edge-computing
description: Build edge computing for IoT: local inference, store-and-forward, OTA updates, constrained resources. Use for edge/fog systems.

name: spatial-computing
description: Build spatial computing (visionOS/ARKit/scene understanding): anchors, occlusion, hand/eye input, comfort. Use for spatial/MR apps.

name: generative-art
description: Create generative/algorithmic art: noise, flow fields, tiling, palettes, plotters, reproducibility (seeds). Use for procedural visual art.

name: creative-coding
description: Build interactive/visual sketches (p5.js/Processing/openFrameworks/three.js): animation loop, input, performance. Use for creative/interactive visuals.

name: music-programming
description: Program music/audio (Web Audio/Tone.js/SuperCollider/MIDI): synthesis, sequencing, timing, scheduling. Use for generative/interactive music.

name: motion-graphics-code
description: Create motion graphics in code (Remotion/Lottie/GSAP/CSS): keyframes, easing, timelines, render pipelines. Use for programmatic animation/video.

name: data-art
description: Turn data into expressive visuals (data-driven art, sonification): mapping, aesthetics, honesty vs artistry. Use for data-art projects.

name: finops-cloud
description: Practice FinOps: cost visibility, allocation/tagging, unit economics, rightsizing, forecasting, showback/chargeback. Use to control cloud spend at org scale.

name: greenops-sustainability
description: Reduce software carbon/energy footprint: efficiency, carbon-aware scheduling, region choice, measurement. Use for sustainability-conscious systems.
